legend: A mouse party is a bunch of mice standing on the vertices of a convex polygon in the two-dimensional plane. When Medea crashes a mouse party, she jumps, out of nowhere, to some point inside the party's polygon. All the mice and Medea can be considered as points in the two-dimensional plane, meaning that they have no shape or dimensions.

Medea is still careful, however. She considers how the mice might encircle her, so that she runs away before they get a chance to do so. Medea defines an encirclement as a subset of exactly three mice such that she lies strictly inside the triangle constructed with the mice as vertices. An example can be seen in Figure M.1.

One day, Medea decided to crash on a party of mice. She does not jump accurately, so she does not know exactly which point inside the mouse party she is going to jump to – all she knows is that she will jump to a uniformly random point with real coordinates inside the mouse party.

Medea wants to know the expected number of distinct encirclements after she lands inside the party. This turned out to be too difficult to calculate, even for Medea's 200 IQ points, so she asked for your help!
input: One line with an integer n$$$n$$$ (3≤n≤2⋅105$$$3 \leq n \leq 2\cdot 10^5$$$), the number of mice.
n$$$n$$$ lines, each with two integers x$$$x$$$ and y$$$y$$$ (|x|,|y|≤107$$$|x|, |y| \leq 10^7$$$), the coordinates of a mouse.
output: Output the expected number of encirclements after Medea lands inside the polygon.
Your answer should have an absolute or relative error of at most 10−4$$$10^{-4}$$$.

legend.ai: 鼠群聚会是指一群老鼠站在二维平面内一个凸多边形的顶点上。当 Medea 闯入鼠群聚会时，她会凭空跳到聚会所在多边形内部的某个点。所有老鼠和 Medea 都可以视为二维平面上的点，也就是说，它们没有形状和大小。
不过，Medea 仍然十分谨慎。她会考虑老鼠可能如何包围自己，以便在老鼠有机会做到之前逃走。Medea 将包围定义为恰好包含三只老鼠的子集，并且她严格位于以这三只老鼠为顶点构成的三角形内部。示例见图 M.1。
一天，Medea 决定闯入一场鼠群聚会。她无法准确地跳跃，因此不知道自己究竟会跳到鼠群聚会内部的哪个点——她只知道自己会跳到鼠群聚会内部一个坐标为实数的均匀随机点。
Medea 想知道自己落在聚会内部后，不同包围的数量的期望值。即使对于拥有 200 IQ 的 Medea 来说，这也太难计算了，所以她向你求助！

input.ai: 一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(3≤n≤2⋅105$$$3 \leq n \leq 2\cdot 10^5$$$)，表示老鼠的数量。
n$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含两个整数 x$$$x$$$ 和 y$$$y$$$(|x|,|y|≤107$$$|x|, |y| \leq 10^7$$$)，表示一只老鼠的坐标。

output.ai: 输出 Medea 降落到多边形内部后预期的环绕次数。
答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10−4$$$10^{-4}$$$。
